checks.command: printf 'BLOCKED: Hermes non-mutating gateway status interface is not established\n'; exit 1

safe_state.switch: hold Hermes gateway configuration and service state unchanged
safe_state.description: Do not restart, stop, or reconfigure a gateway automatically; use the human-approved Hermes status interface to diagnose an unavailable gateway.

sampling.what: Daily Hermes gateway status result for the currently configured profile; do not include environment variables, credentials, or profile-specific private details.
sampling.working_well: Hermes reports the gateway as running for the active configured profile; missing CLI or status support is reported as unavailable, not green.

open_decisions: Confirm the installed Hermes CLI's exact non-mutating status command and its output contract before replacing the blocked draft command; gateway health must be checked for the currently configured profile without assuming a systemd unit name.
